development: Retrospective geometry/rank checks on the ten known exact pairs. No prospective pair outcomes computed.

protocol.flatness: maximum sorted branch range / ||S||2 <= 1e-8; all branches including constant zeros
protocol.coverage: Predicted-flat / actually flat in qualified sample; also report call-rate / all qualified
protocol.false_positive: Predicted-flat but nonflat, among qualified predicted-flat; exact one-sided 95% CP upper plus two-sided 95% upper
protocol.intervals: Wilson 95% for coverage and call-rate; IID pair interpretation, catalogue-specific

order: For each test: the classifier was frozen with its checksum recorded; the sample was drawn and recorded; every prediction was made from geometry alone and the prediction file was sealed with its checksum; only then were lifted spectra computed. The classifier file here is byte-identical to the frozen file.
